spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (चणति)
1 To give.
2 To sound.
3 To hurt or kill.

m. (-कः)
1 Chick-pea, (Cicer arietinum.)
2 The name of a sage.
f. (-का)
Linseed.
E.
चण to be given, affix अच् and कन् added; what is given to horses, &c.

m. (-जः)
The name of a sage; also called VĀTSYĀYANA.
E.
चणक, and आत्मज born; the son of CAṆAKA.

n. (-कं)
Pease with salt.
E.
चणक, and अम्ल acid.

n. (-र्)
Water drops on the leaves of the Cicer.
E.
चणकाम्ल, and बार् water.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
1 Fierce, violent, passionate.
2 Hot, warm.
2 Pungent, acrid.
m. (-ण्डः)
1 The tamarind tree.
2 A messenger of

YAMA.
3

A Daitya, a demon.
f. (-ण्डा)
1 A perfume, commonly

Cor.
2

A kind of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.)
3 The name of a river in the east of

Bengal.
4

A goddess peculiar to the Jainas.
f. (-ण्डा-ण्डी)
A name of the goddess DURGĀ, applied especially to her incarnation for the purpose of destroying Mahiṣāsura; this exploit forms the subject of a section of the Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa, and is particularly celebrated in Bengal at the Durgā Pūja, or festival held in honour of the goddess, towards the close of the year, (Oct.-Nov.)
(-ण्डी)
1 A passionate woman.
2 A mischievous or furious woman.
3 A species of the Atijagatī verse.
n. (-ण्डं)
1 Heat, warmth.
2 Passion, wrath.
E.
चडि to be wrathful, ड Uṇādi affix, and टा or ङीप् affixes of the feminine gender.

f. (-ता)
1 Warmth, pungency.
2 Warmth of temper, passionateness.
E.
चण्ड angry, and तल् abstract affix; also with त्व, चण्डत्वं.

m. (-तः)
A fragrant plant, (Nerium odorum); also प्रतीहास.
E.
चण्ड heat, and अत to go or be, affix अण्.

f. (-का)
1 The goddess

DURGĀ.
2

One of the eight Nāyikās.
E.
चण्ड a demon, and नायिका mistress.

f. (-का)
Knowledge of mystical nature, acquired by worship of the Nāyikās.
E.
चण्ड, and रुद्र ŚIVA, वुन् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Passionate, violent, warm.
f. (-ती)
1 A name or form of

DURGĀ.
2

One of her attendants.
E.
चण्ड anger, and मतुप् poss. aff.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A short petticoat.
E.
चण्डा an angry woman, अत to go, and वुन् affix; it being described as the garb of women of some consequence, and therefore privileged to give themselves airs.

m. (-लः)
An outcaste, a Cāṇḍāla, the generic name for a man of the lowest of the mixed tribes, born from a Śūdra father and Brahman mother.
E.
चण्ड angry, and अल able, or चण्ड to be angry, and आलञ् Uṇādi affix; proper to execute all vile or barbarous acts; also चाण्डाल.

m. (-लः)
A name of an impure or degraded tribe, a Caṇḍāla, a Pariah, an outcaste.
f. (-ली)
A woman of the same tribe.
E.
चडि to be angry, Uṇādi affix आलञ्, and according to some अण् added; also चण्डाल.

f. (-की)
A common or vulgar lute.
E.
चण्डाल an outcaste, and वल्लकी a lute.

f. (-का)
1 A common lute.
2 A name of the goddess

DURGĀ.
3

A plant.
E.
चण्डाल, and इकन् affix; or चण्ड a demon, &c. आली a line or troop, and कन् affix; hence also चण्डालीका.

f. (-का)
1 A vulgar lute.
2 A name of

DURGĀ.
3
A kind of herb: see चण्डालिका.

m. (-शुः)
The sun.
E.
चण्ड hot, अंशु ray.

f. (-का)
The goddess DURGĀ.
E.
कण् added to चण्डी q. v. also चण्डा and चण्डी.

m. (-लः)
1 A barber.
2 A name of Ś

IVA.
3

A kind of potherb: see बास्तूक.
f. (-ला)
The name of a river.
E.
चडि to be wrathful, or to cause wrath, and इलच् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-ण्डी)
DURGĀ. see चण्ड.

m. (-मः)
Red oleander.
E.
चण्डी, and कुसुम a flower.

m. (-ण्डुः)
1 A rat.
2 A small monkey, (Simia erythroea.)
E.
चडि to be passionate, उ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Fit for or sown with the chickpea, (a field, &c.)
E.
चणक chickpea, and खञ् aff.

m. (-क्यः)
1 A name of the sage

VĀTSYĀYANA.
2

Name of a Brahman, the reputed author of a work on polity, and minister of CANDRAGUPTA.
n. (-क्यं)
The work of Cāṇakya, detached stanzas original or compiled, on morals and polity.
E.
चणक a saint, and यञ् affix of descent.

m. (-रः)
A wrestler in the service of KAṂSA.

m. (-नः)
KṚṢṆA.
E.
चाणूर, and सूदन destroyer.
